detail: Owner-region tourism authority describes the 1890 Chiang Saen ordination hall, nine overlapping gold-plated stupa courses on an octagonal base, and one-storey traditional wooden Phra Yok Hall.

Mae Fah Luang University regional cultural database documents three by five ordination-hall bays, projecting roof ends, 1960 remodelling, 2007 finial mounting, and the 1995 two-storey teak-clad museum.
